name: Calf Raise

instructions.description: Stand tall with feet hip width apart near a wall or stable support if needed.
Shift weight evenly through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping the ankles aligned and the toes relaxed.
Lower the heels slowly back to the floor with control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Perform through the largest pain-free range available.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Lift one foot to increase load on the working side.

commentsNotes: Avoid rolling the ankles outward or inward.
Use fingertip support rather than leaning heavily.
